verdicts.reason: Both put "$3" above "2 FOR", so the offer reads backwards. Both also move the FIZZBANG logo from top-centre to an oversized pill crammed into the bottom-left corner, off the centre axis and nearly touching the left and bottom edges, and both leave dead pink space at the top. A edges ahead only because its can is slightly larger and has more presence; B shrinks the product further, so the hero image feels trivial.
